_comment: Pane ids as herdr may spell them, with C0 characters in them: a BEL and a vertical tab. Godot's JSON.stringify() leaves the first raw and writes the second as the invalid escape \v, so a subscription naming them is valid JSON only through HerdrClient.request_line(). The office cleans them out of the ids it draws (ctl:p1, ctl:p2); herdr's own spelling is what requests carry.
